note: Canon, rhubarb (rawand), entry canon.b2.h0693: 'the dose is two dirhams in a mixed syrup', for falls, blows and muscle tears. Content range is total hydroxyanthracene derivatives expressed as rhein (3-12 percent of the dried root, EMA/HMPC/113701/2019); most is present as glycosides, so free rhein at the dose is lower. The modelled constituent is rhein itself, which overestimates immediate free rhein exposure.

Canon, anise (anisun), entry canon.b2.h0027: 'the full dose on its own is half a dirham', as a carminative for wind and colic. Content = essential oil 1.5-6 percent v/w times trans-anethole 80-95 percent of the oil (EMA/HMPC/321181/2012); volume-to-mass conversion ignored (oil density not verified), so the range is approximate.
